title: UI风格#111 - Memphis Design (孟菲斯设计)
description: 创建第111种UI风格：孟菲斯设计风格 - 80年代意大利、几何形状、鲜艳色彩、波浪图案。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planDG.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Memphis Design style When color palette Then features bright yellow, hot pink, electric blue, black and white patterns
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#FFDE00 (亮黄), #FF6B9D (热粉), #00BFFF (电蓝), #000000 (黑白), #FF6B6B (珊瑚)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Memphis Design style When typography Then uses playful fonts: Helvetica, Futura, or Cavolini
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Helvetica (经典), Futura (几何), Cavolini (装饰)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Memphis Design style When layout Then terry towelling, zigzag patterns, confetti shapes, dot grids
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：毛圈织物、锯齿图案、彩屑形状、点阵网格

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Memphis Design style When UI elements Then geometric bouncing, terry textures, pattern overlays
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：几何弹跳、织物纹理、图案叠加、活泼动画

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Memphis Design UI When functional Then includes playful chat, pattern agents, squigle stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：活泼聊天、图案代理、曲线统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Memphis Design UI When copy Then uses playful: 'Squigle', 'Confetti', 'Pattern', 'Terry'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'SQUIGLE. CONFETTI. PATTERN.'、按钮'SEND'→'BOUNCE'、'SUBMIT'→'SPRING'
